summary: App to save and organize recorded lecture links, with notes/reminders, so the user can easily remember and access lecture video links (stored separately, like a drive/notes app).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Flat illustration of a bookmarked notebook with a play button on the cover, warm amber and cream tones (lecture-vault-logo.dim_256x256.png)

existing_features.title: Build a frontend page that allows users to save a new recorded lecture link by entering a title, the video URL, an optional notes/description, and an optional label/category. Display a confirmation after saving.

Build a frontend drive-style list view that displays all saved lecture links. Each entry should show the title, label/category badge, notes snippet, creation date, and a clickable button to open the video URL in a new tab.
Add search and filter functionality to the lecture list so users can search by title or notes keyword, and filter by label/category.
Allow users to delete a saved lecture link entry from the list view.

Apply a clean, modern notebook/drive-inspired visual theme — warm neutral tones (cream, amber, slate), clear card-based layout, readable typography, and subtle folder/bookmark iconography — consistently across all pages and components.

new_feature_requests.summary: Save and organize recorded lecture links with notes/labels for easy recall
Store links in a list/drive-like view so user can remember and access them later

Create a backend data model and API to store recorded lecture links. Each entry should have: a title, a URL (the lecture recording link), an optional description/notes field, a label/category tag, and a creation timestamp.
